mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month signals accommodative policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test comparing to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising concurrently (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates signal higher interest costs, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when FEDFUNDS rises in a tightening cycle (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the INDPRO supply index indicates robust supply growth, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when INDPRO is rising (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP surge above $20 billion signals strong demand, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 20000 in next quarter
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when GDPC1 crosses above 20000 (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant rises in employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market strength, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when both PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime, a decline in INDPRO below 100 signals disruptions, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when INDPRO drops below 100 in supply shock regime (p>0.05).
